common_grid.xy_axis_policy: local x is source/output column coordinate in metres; local y is source/output row coordinate in metres; no y-axis flip is applied for paired CI/MSH evaluation
common_grid.main_evaluation_grid_policy: CI-EXT and MSH-EXT are separate real-terrain map environments. Each scene is optimized and evaluated only on its own frozen DEM inside the logical mission bounds [0,4610]x[0,5000] m. CI-EXT uses its frozen Christmas-Island-derived 923x1001, 5 m DEM reconstructed from the NMOPSO source-map context. MSH-EXT uses the frozen native 1 m Mount St. Helens LiDAR DEM as the main terrain, with a small native-resolution support margin stored only to make boundary interpolation/audit deterministic. Raw fitness values are reported per scene and are never averaged across scenes.

mission.overfly_policy: threats are vertical no-fly cylinders; overflight is forbidden regardless of path altitude

physical_decode.height_encoding: uz is normalized AGL relative to each scene's own DEM, not global absolute altitude

optimizer.st_v_policy: reuse project ST_V unchanged; do not scale velocities to physical metres
optimizer.evaluation_policy: fitness, AGL, collision, path length, and energy are computed after physical decoding on the scene-specific terrain; all algorithms in a scene share the same map, constraints, evaluator, and 20100-evaluation budget
optimizer.post_decode_path_repair_policy: disabled_for_all_algorithms; the external experiment may clip optimizer variables through existing bounds, but it must not project, densify, or otherwise repair decoded paths for only some algorithms before final evaluation
optimizer.boundary_interpolation_policy: points outside the logical mission bounds [0,4610]x[0,5000] m are invalid for every scene. Exact outer pixel centres are evaluated with the adjacent/native support block when available; any NoData neighbour in that support block remains invalid. MSH support-margin cells beyond the logical bounds are never valid path/evaluation locations.

ci_ext.source_description: Frozen ChrismasTerrain2.tif 5 m GeoTIFF for the Christmas-Island-derived CI-EXT terrain, reconstructed from the NMOPSO source-code map context and retained in its native metric grid for this external experiment.
ci_ext.source_policy: use the frozen repository GeoTIFF as the CI-EXT map; preserve native 5 m metric terrain, NoData mask, CRS, and extent; do not resize to 200x200 m or normalize elevations
ci_ext.coordinate_policy: NMOPSO one-based source indices are converted with x_local=(column-1)*5 and y_local=(row-1)*5; protocol coordinates are already in metres
ci_ext.nodata_policy: NoData is invalid only; never replace NoData by zero, terrain minimum, or interpolation
ci_ext.bilinear_policy: if any of the four bilinear neighbours is NoData, terrain height is invalid; exact outer pixel centres use the adjacent interior support block
ci_ext.path_policy: any path sample falling outside the valid DEM mask is infeasible

msh_ext.source_description: 2017 Mount St. Helens 1 m bare-earth LiDAR DEM, referenced by the external DEM protocol as USGS DOI 10.5066/P9H16RC7 and frozen locally from the official NOAA Digital Coast / USFS_GiffordPinchot_2017_9807 GeoTIFF tile distribution.
msh_ext.source_license: CC0 as recorded in the external DEM protocol source description
msh_ext.source_distribution: NOAA Digital Coast public S3 GeoTIFF tiles under USFS_GiffordPinchot_2017_9807
msh_ext.source_policy: resolve 16 required tiles from official urllist9807.txt or an official tile directory; do not guess date suffixes; preserve the native 1 m metric terrain for MSH-EXT evaluation
msh_ext.vertical_datum: NAVD88, as distributed in the NOAA/USFS source tiles

one_m_window.role: native 1 m support window for MSH-EXT; main evaluation is clipped to logical_window and never permits samples in the extra support margin

logical_window.role: actual MSH-EXT optimization, fitness, metrics, and final path-audit terrain domain

msh_ext.support_margin_policy: The saved 4615x5005 1 m GeoTIFF keeps a 4 m native-resolution support margin relative to the 4611x5001 logical mission window. The support margin exists only for deterministic interpolation and the retained 5 m diagnostic grid; it is not part of the valid mission area.

five_m_grid.resampling: strict 5x5 average from the aligned 1m window
five_m_grid.role: derived diagnostic/compatibility product only; not used for MSH-EXT main ranking

run_protocol.pilot_policy: run one-seed smoke tests only after protocol validation, unit tests, and deterministic scene audit pass
